reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Fair question. Beginner means you're still learning the lifts and getting stronger almost every week, usually under a year of consistent training. Intermediate means you've been at it a year or two, your progress has slowed, and you're chasing small gains through structured progression. Advanced means several years of steady training, where progress comes in inches and needs careful planning. Roughly how long have you been training?"}
